summary: Regression test of navigation-pattern change for Betalingen (desktop) and Borg. Verified list→detail→back pattern matches Betalingsregelingen/PlanDetail. Mobile Betalingen inline-expand preserved. All primary flows PASS.

test_details.desktop_betalingen_list_to_detail: PASS — Stepped back 2 months to juni 2026 (28 payments). Clicking payment-row-<id> replaces list with payment-detail-page-<id>. Back button (payment-detail-back) visible. Title=tenant name, subtitle=receipt+date, status/category/method badges present, amount top-right, DetailRows (Kwitantie, Datum, Huurder, Appartement, Categorie, Methode, Goedgekeurd door, Notitie). All 4 action buttons present (payment-pdf-<id>, payment-email-<id>, payment-secure-pdf-<id>, payment-delete-<id>). Rows-during-detail = 0 (list fully replaced).
test_details.desktop_betalingen_back: PASS — Clicking back returns to list with 28 rows on juni 2026 (month filter preserved). Silent reload confirmed.
test_details.mobile_betalingen_preserved: PASS — Viewport 390x844. Clicking mp-card-<id> shows mp-detail-<id> INLINE. No payment-detail-page-* rendered on mobile. Existing POS-style expand intact.
test_details.desktop_borg_list_to_detail: PASS — 1 deposit present (refunded status). Clicking dep-row-<id> loads deposit-detail-page-<id>. deposit-detail-back visible. Shows tenant title (Bharat Kewalbansing), 'Appt. HUIS 7B' subtitle, Gerestitueerd badge, amount SRD 5.009,00 top-right, DetailRows (Huurder, Appartement, Valuta, Terugbetaald SRD 1.009,00). Rows on detail = 0.
test_details.desktop_borg_actions_refunded: PASS — For refunded deposit: dep-pdf-<id> + dep-delete-<id> visible; dep-refund-<id> correctly hidden (Restitueer only shown for held status).
test_details.desktop_borg_back: PASS — Back button returns to list view.
test_details.desktop_borg_refund_flow: NOT TESTED — No 'held' deposit available in seed data (only 1 deposit, already refunded). Code review of Deposits.jsx line 233 confirms RefundForm.onSaved={ () => { setRefunding(null); setDetail(null); load(); } } correctly clears detail and returns to list.
test_details.regression_new_deposit_modal: PASS (implicit — dep-new-btn present, empty state renders when no deposits).

critical_code_review_comments: Payments.jsx has duplicate data-testid='month-prev'/'month-next'/'month-stepper-label' (rendered once in mobile section, once in desktop). Both exist in DOM (one hidden via CSS). Playwright strict-mode picks up 2. Minor — consider suffixing with -mobile/-desktop OR wrapping stepper in one media-query'd tree. Not blocking.

Payments.jsx line 1212: `const _unused = [CalendarDays, CheckCircle2];` — CheckCircle2 is actually used in ApprovePaymentSheet, so this comment/holder is misleading (safe to remove). Also `Check` import in Deposits.jsx is used (RefundForm submit + Restitueer).
Deposits.jsx line 148: `del()` uses window.confirm — inconsistent with Payments.jsx which uses a styled AlertTriangle modal. Consider unifying UX (already flagged historically).
PaymentDetail lacks 'Goedgekeurd door' guard — renders 'Dado Vastgoed Beheer' (works fine, but confirm data source for legacy payments).
seed_data_creation: None. Existing seed had 28 payments in juni 2026 and 1 refunded deposit (Bharat Kewalbansing / HUIS 7B).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To fully test Borg refund flow (held → RefundForm → returns to list), a NEW deposit must be created first (existing one is refunded). URL pattern is /{slug}/admin/payments and /{slug}/admin/deposits where slug=surirent for admin@vastgoed.sr. Duplicate testids for month-prev/month-next exist due to mobile+desktop wrappers.
rca of the issue: N/A — this is a feature verification, not a bug hunt. Fix applied by main agent works as designed: PaymentRow now uses onOpen callback (Payments.jsx line 396), main Payments() has detailPayment state with early-return rendering PaymentDetail (line 899-909). Deposits.jsx uses same pattern with `detail` state (line 140, 153-236). Mobile still uses `expanded` state + MobilePaymentCard onClick=toggleExpand (line 993).
